project_context.name: Mock Test Club (ExamNest)
project_context.goal: High-conversion, heavily animated, non-generic AI slop redesign keeping all existing functionality and data fetching intact.

theme_strategy.archetype: The Performance Pro meets Swiss Brutalism
theme_strategy.rationale: Indian competitive exams (NEET/JEE) require intense focus and high energy. We reject generic 'SaaS blue' and soft pastels. Instead, we use high-contrast brutalist structures to convey authority, paired with vivid 'Volt' accents to convey kinetic energy. We retain the warm cream base (#FAF7F2) to keep the app grounded and approachable.

rules.contrast: Ensure APCA contrast ratio. Never use pure #000000. Never use full transparent backgrounds for nav.

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous Spacing: p-8, p-12, p-16, py-24, py-32.

grid_system.bento_mode_a: Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8. Span logic: Hero/Dominant (col-span-8 row-span-2), Square (col-span-4 row-span-1).

cards.override_en_card: Redefine existing 'en-card' style to: Neumorphic-brutalist hybrid: Flat backgrounds matching parent, sharp 1px border (#09090B/10), crisp layered shadows for hover (-translate-y-1, shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(9,9,11,1)]).

glassmorphism.style: Optical Clarity for Nav/Sticky elements: bg-white/70, backdrop-blur-xl, backdrop-saturate-150, 1px bottom border border-black/5.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white font-semibold rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:bg-[#D92D24] transition-transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-[0_4px_14px_0_rgb(255,59,48,39%)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-[#09090B] border border-[#09090B]/20 rounded-full px-8 py-4 hover:border-[#09090B] hover:bg-black/5 transition-all

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis (or Framer Motion scroll hooks) is highly recommended for premium feel.

micro_interactions.hover: Scale transforms, layered shadow reveals, border color shifts.
micro_interactions.entrance: Upgrade 'en-fade-up' to use framer-motion staggering. Spring physics: stiffness 100, damping 15.

specific_effects.hero_parallax: Images/elements in hero move at different scroll speeds.
specific_effects.marquee: Slow, elegant drift for logos. Use framer-motion infinite translate.
specific_effects.stats: Animated counter triggered by intersection observer.

nav.design: Sticky top, Crystal Glassmorphism, clearly visible logo and main CTA.

hero.layout: Asymmetric. Left: Massive H1 + Subtitle + CTAs + Batch Toggle (Segmented control UI). Right: Overlapping Framer Motion dashboard mockup card ('en-card') and abstract student visuals.
hero.motion: Staggered entrance. Mockup card floats slightly (y-axis ping-pong). Override 'en-grid-bg' for a crisp technical grid behind.

media_strip.design: Marquee containing sponsor/featured logos, grayscale, opacity-60 hover:opacity-100.

stats_strip.design: Dark background (#0F172A), bright text (#FAF7F2) and Accent (#FF3B30). Grid of 3 counters.

cbt_preview.design: MUST mimic NTA exam colors exactly for functional recognition (Green=Answered, Red=Not Answered, Purple=Review, etc.), but elevate the container UI with glassmorphism or sleek technical borders (Retro-Futurism/Terminal look with 1px grid borders).
cbt_preview.interaction: Interactive mock-buttons for question palette (hover states, click ripple).

features_bento.layout: Mode A (Tetris Grid). 6 modules. 1 dominant (col-span-8), 2 squares, 1 tall. Varied bg colors.
features_bento.design: Crisp borders, generous padding (p-8 or p-12). Lucide-react icons with stroke-width 1.5.

courses_grid.design: Live fetched data. Cards with crisp hover shadows. Prominent price/rating.
courses_grid.action: Maintain existing API calls (/api/courses). CTAs clearly visible.

toppers_grid.design: Tight grid, bold AIR ranks in accent color, small student avatars.

counselling_form.design: High-contrast card. Side-by-side layout: Form on left, live-chat mock visual on right. Shadcn Form components heavily styled.

faq.design: Clean accordion, sharp borders, large typography. No boxes, just lines (border-b border-[#09090B]/10).

footer.design: Dark mode (#0F172A) to create massive contrast shift. Massive text element 'ACE THE EXAM'. py-24.

hero_student.description: Focused young woman studying, representing the target aspirant demographic.

hero_abstract.description: Creative geometric shape, use as floating element behind hero mockup.

bento_abstract.description: Vibrant abstract shapes, place inside one of the bento boxes to add visual flair.

accessibility.contrast: All text must pass APCA/WCAG AA.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query. Use framer-motion useReducedMotion hook.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='enroll-button').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Prioritize optical alignment over strict geometric alignment.
Do NOT use HTML-based generic components for complex interactions; heavily style Radix/Shadcn UI.
Do NOT apply global transition: all.
Never center-align large blocks of text; keep left-aligned for readability.
Ensure all API integrations (courses, counselling) remain completely intact and functional.
Use Lucide-react for iconography, maintaining a consistent stroke width.
For shadows, use crisp brutalist styles (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_#000]) or highly diffused premium shadows. No default generic grays.
Do NOT use placeholder images from dummyimage/placeholder.com. Use provided image URLs.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, and forms for automation support.
